notes.title: Change clothes? 換衣服? 着替えをする
notes.content:
How to change clothes?
Beat a monster!
After the appreciation mode is unlocked!
Clothes can be changed in appreciative mode

如何換服裝？
擊敗一個怪獸！
在鑒賞模式解鎖後！
衣服可以在鑒賞模式進行換裝

服装はどう変えますか。
怪獣を倒した！
鑑賞モードの解除後！
服は鑑賞モードで着替えることができる

notes.title: The new version has been updated.
notes.content:
The new version has been updated.
Fixed some errors! Adjusted the collision edge of characters!
Fixed the problem of being stuck in the box.
MAC OS SUPPORTED
Increased:
Option -- Image -- Disable flashing effects
Option -- control -- move speed adjustment

notes.title: The first season! Already arrived!
notes.content:
The first season! Already arrived!

A new game similar to the magic tower (which can shuttle between different floors).
Medium difficulty new level waiting for players who are not satisfied with the status quo to challenge!
The 10 way to get the collectibles (by season bonus in the collection project, through the box draw).
Score high on the list with your friends.

Increase speed control in control options
Optimized the gallery system and increased the zoom and move of your collection monster pictures.
DLC
Add spiral maze, 8 new monster & 1 very precious treasures.
Thank you for your support and love for this little game!
